bio: Malmaison Liverpool is a stylish boutique hotel next to the famous Pier Head and Albert Dock, overlooking the River Mersey, within walking distance of the city's attractions.  Malmaison have re-imagined the classic Afternoon Tea menu. Savouries include the Chez Mal beef slider on brioche bun, Cumberland sausage & apple roll and prawn cocktail. Sweet treats include Calamansi citrus meringue tart, dark chocolate & salted caramel tart and raspberry ripple & white chocolate sundae.  For a special occasion choose the The Cocktail Afternoon Tea, with a choice of cocktails from the Classic or Signature collection, including Mojito, Cosmopolitan and three types of Negroni! There are also menu options which include a glass of Prosecco or Cuvée Malmaison Brut Champagne.  Special dietary requirements are catered for, with alternative menus for vegetarians/vegans and for those with gluten and nut allergies. Pre-booking is required. Please specify dietary needs using the 'Special Request' field.  All Afternoon Tea menus are served with a choice of teas and infusions, including English breakfast, Earl Grey and Green tea with jasmine.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Sunday from 12pm to 4pm and costs £29.50 per person.
